# meshstack_users (Data Source)

List meshUsers, optionally only those with access to a workspace or project. Deleted users are not listed. Use it to check many usernames at once, for example the members of `meshstack_workspace_user_group` resources.

~> Needs an API key with the admin permission `ADM_USER_LIST`. meshStack has no workspace-scoped permission to list users: the `workspace_identifier` filter narrows the list for such a key and grants no access.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "meshstack_users" "all" {}

locals {
  wanted_members    = ["jane.doe@example.com", "john.doe@example.com"]
  known_usernames   = toset(data.meshstack_users.all.users[*].metadata.name)
  unknown_usernames = setsubtract(local.wanted_members, local.known_usernames)
}

check "members_are_known_users" {
  assert {
    condition     = length(local.unknown_usernames) == 0
    error_message = "meshStack knows no user with the username ${join(", ", local.unknown_usernames)}."
  }
}
```

```terraform
data "meshstack_users" "workspace_managers" {
  workspace_identifier = data.meshstack_workspace.example.metadata.name
  workspace_role       = "Workspace Manager"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `project_identifier` (String) List only users with access to this project. Requires `workspace_identifier`, because a project identifier is only unique within its workspace.
- `workspace_identifier` (String) List only users with a role in this workspace, directly or through a group.
- `workspace_role` (String) List only users with this workspace role, such as `Workspace Manager`, directly or through a group.

### Read-Only

- `users` (Attributes List) The users, in the order meshStack created them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users))

<a id="nestedatt--users"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users`

Read-Only:

- `metadata` (Attributes) Identifiers of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--metadata))
- `ref` (Attributes) Reference to this user, can be used as `user_ref` in `meshstack_workspace_user_group_member`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--ref))
- `spec` (Attributes) Profile of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--spec))
- `status` (Attributes) Information meshStack keeps about the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--status))

<a id="nestedatt--users--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.metadata`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Username of the user. A workspace user group lists its members by it, and a user binding names the user by it in `subject.name`.
- `uuid` (String) UUID of the user.


<a id="nestedatt--users--ref"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.ref`

Read-Only:

- `kind` (String) meshObject type, always `meshUser`.
- `name` (String) Named identifier (`metadata.name`) of `meshUser`.


<a id="nestedatt--users--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.spec`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) Email address of the user.
- `euid` (String) External user ID, which meshStack uses to find the user in the cloud platforms.
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user.
- `tags` (Map of List of String) Tags of `meshUser`.


<a id="nestedatt--users--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.status`

Read-Only:

- `last_login` (String) When the user last signed in to meshPanel. Null for a user who has never signed in.
- `lifecycle` (Attributes) Lifecycle of the user. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--users--status--lifecycle))

<a id="nestedatt--users--status--lifecycle"></a>
### Nested Schema for `users.status.lifecycle`

Read-Only:

- `state` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `DEACTIVATED` for a user your identity provider has deactivated.
